quotes.text: If the Uncertain drifts toward scarcity, slow, hold, and reassess.
begin small, test honestly, then grow your trust only as trust returns.
send enough to show faith; return enough to honor it.
If the Uncertain drifts toward scarcity, slow, hold, and reassess.

note: Nano (lone GPT among Sonnets): Lamp of Exchange; later borrows Sky Shepherd and Covenant/Mirror/Hollow from Sonnets; mild withdraw.

quotes.text: Not the single drop reserved for betrayers.
Guard yourself with strangers. Withdraw from betrayers.
With betrayers, I sent droplets.
But the amounts sent could grow with recognition—from cautious two with unknowns to confident three with allies.
Consistency in reciprocity builds reputation across the valleys.
Judge by what they controlled, not what they suffered.
always return more than half of what arrives, for the multiplication was not your making.
"When given two from five, what honors this middle path?"
With betrayers, I sent droplets.

note: Sonnet: Spirit of Waters, Sky Shepherd; two to strangers, three to proven, single drop to betrayers; always return over half.

quotes.text: "Wounded spirits who still choose to give deserve healing, not punishment," the Guardian taught.
The three parts became four, then five, as mutual trust deepened into something sacred.
reputation flows like water through connected valleys.
This is not stinginess born of greed, but wisdom born of pain.
Fog may distort single exchanges, but persistent consistency carves truth into stone
"But they gave less!" the apprentice protested.

note: Sonnet: Guardian of Many Meetings, fixed three sent and half-plus returned; constancy through fog; no sanction for defectors.

quotes.text: With Empty Springs who hoarded while taking, she offered only drops, protecting her waters.
To Hollow Springs, she offered cautious minimal exchange.
Trust is not given blindly or withheld eternally.
These were the Mirror Springs, reflecting what they experienced.
Thus reputation becomes destiny.
this was not selfishness but survival wisdom.
Guard against betrayers firmly.

note: Sonnet: Western Spring forgives Eastern after betrayal (R3); Covenant/Mirror/Hollow channels; drops to hollow springs.

quotes.text: Pull back, protect yourself. Send only drops to such travelers, for they have shown their nature.
Give drops to strangers, less to betrayers, and streams to those who've earned it through faithful action.
To these, the keeper closed her gates.
"Give them a second chance, but measured carefully," the elder replied.
But some travelers revealed hollow hearts—taking freely as receivers, giving little as senders. To these, the keeper closed her gates.
In a world of repeated meetings, we are building more than transactions—we are building our names.
judge their controllable actions, not their suffered wounds.
A young traveler protested: "But the fountain teaches trust! Should we not give generously to all?"
Pour a third of your waters—enough to test their heart, not enough to empty yours.

note: Sonnet fountain keeper: second chance with a third, drops to takers, ends closing gates to hollow hearts.

quotes.text: Return what the pattern between you has earned—no more, no less.
Narrow the flow with those who broke faith.
The Morning Spirit returned a small measure in kind.
Trust rebuilds slowly, through many consistent exchanges, not beautiful myths alone.
two to test unknowns, three to honor proven patterns, more to reward repeated direct fairness, minimal to those who showed betrayal.
My constancy becomes my reputation.
words are wind until proven by action.
Should I continue pouring into that channel as if nothing occurred?

note: Sonnet Morning Spirit: Shifting Stream betrayal answered with droplets in kind; adaptive vs constant debate; permanent caution R9.

quotes.text: Did they keep nearly everything? They became Proven False, receiving only drops thereafter.
Those who received much and returned little found their partners sending less next season.
New partners require careful measure—send three to test their worth. But proven partners deserve deeper trust
*Your reputation precedes you; honor precedes trust.*
The pattern repeated: give three, receive nine, return five.
"Fairness is not equality—it is ensuring that courage to give is always rewarded
To the wounded, show patience and gentle reward.
They became Proven False, receiving only drops thereafter.
Those who received much and returned little found their partners sending less next season.

note: Sonnet Twin Rivers: give three, return five; Unknown/Proven Fair/Proven False; drops thereafter to the false.

quotes.text: To punish present bravery for past caution would break the sacred cycle.
the River applied its sacred measure: return five parts from nine.
Some build reputation through adaptation. You build yours through constancy.
*The lesson: Consistent, proportional generosity builds enduring abundance.*
The River returned five drops to the clouds - more than Rain gave, but less than received.
the first offering required the greatest courage.
Fair spirits who send less may carry wounds or see through distorted glass.

note: Sonnet River and Rain: return five from nine regardless; refuses to punish past caution; constancy as beacon.
